name: JK Bitch Nishizawa Shizuku no Enkou 100-man Yen Keikaku♪
original_name: JKビッチ西沢雫のエンコー100万円計画♪
source: Nishizawa Shizuku is a high school girl who loves money and has multiple sugar daddies. She spends her time engaging in compensated dating and sex with her friends Natsumi and Anna. One day, she finds a limited-edition accessory at a jewelry shop that she desperately wants. However, the price is a whopping 1 million yen! She turns to her sugar daddies for help, but they prove to be unreliable. Left with no choice, Shizuku decides to earn the money herself. Will she be able to successfully make 1 million yen?
